title: Frost Eveque - Location, Lightning Weakness & Rewards
description: The Frost Eveque in Expedition 33 is weak to Lightning, not Fire, despite the name. Location north of Stone Quarry, phase 2 details and rewards.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Frost Eveque is an optional boss on The Continent, and one of three elemental Eveque variants. It has a second phase and a weak spot that does not work.

sections.title: Where to Find the Frost Eveque
sections.content:
Location: The Continent - the southern end of the snowy area in the middle of the map, just north of the Stone Quarry and west of the Coastal Cave.

It is alone, floating in the middle of a snowy arena, with several stone statues leading up to it. You can reach this spot once you have made it through the Forgotten Battlefield, and you need Esquie's swim ability.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toLightning
ResistsFire, Dark, Earth, Light, Physical
AbsorbsIce

The counterintuitive part: it is weak to Lightning, not Fire. Fire is resisted like everything else. Do not assume the name tells you the answer.

sections.title: The Weak Spot Is Bugged
sections.content:
The Frost Eveque has a visible weak spot - a glowing orb at the centre of its chest - but it does not register any extra damage. It appears to be a bug.

Do not build a strategy around hitting it. Aim for the Lightning weakness instead.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Energising Gradient
  • Resplendent Chroma Catalyst x2
  • Colour of Lumina x5
  • 180,000 EXP

sections.title: How to Beat the Frost Eveque
sections.content:
There is a second phase at 30% HP

When it drops to roughly 30% health it powers up and becomes noticeably more aggressive: it uses a new Gradient Attack and its melee attack becomes faster. The timing on its other attacks stays the same.

Lightning is the whole plan

Recommended skills: Lune's Lightning Dance, Thunderfall or Electrify. Equip a Lightning-affinity weapon so your free aim and adaptive skills also convert to Lightning.

Stack Mark for extra damage

Have someone apply Mark first, then follow with your Lightning burst:

  • Verso - Defiant Strike or Marking Shot
  • Sciel - Marking Card
  • Monoco - Chapelier Slash or Echassier Stabs

Then follow up with a high-damage Lightning skill. Suggested loadouts from the community: Kralim + Lightning on Lune, Brulerum to stack Burns on Maelle, and Dualiso on Verso.

Attack reads

  • Spear - it charges the spear, pulses, then plunges it; after the first strike it creates up to 3 shockwaves hitting the whole team (up to 4 damage instances). Parry on the first strike
  • Ice Blast - it turns to its side and holds an orb in its right hand; parry after the pulse, but note there is a slight delay after the sound cue
  • Energy Blast (phase 2) - screen turns monochromatic just before it fires at a single target; press as the blast fires for a gradient counter
  • Full Power / Tremor - a crawling wave with up to 9 damage instances; the parry timing is on the third step
